entries.value: MEGGA Real Estate: SaaS immobilier suisse AI-native, compliance-first. Marketplace publique (33k+ biens Flatfox location) + CRM transactionnel agent + pipeline LAB/KYC + portail vendeur + copilote IA + super-admin. Stack React/Vite sur Cloudflare Pages + Supabase (Postgres, 57 edge functions, RLS, pg_cron). L'IA est compliance-enabling, jamais compliance-replacing.

Les 5 objectifs strategiques (toute feature doit en servir au moins 1): 1) reduire le temps administratif, 2) reduire le risque LAB/KYC, 3) accelerer le closing, 4) augmenter la transparence client, 5) remplacer un outil fragmente.

Frontend: React 18 + TypeScript + Vite + Tailwind. React Router v6, React Query (+ supabase-cache-helpers), react-hook-form + Zod, dnd-kit (pipeline kanban), Mapbox GL (lazy), Recharts, Lucide, react-i18next (FR/DE/EN/IT), Sentry, PostHog. Build: tsc -b && vite build (+ postbuild overlay-storefront).

Backend: Supabase Pro (ref eayczugyrvmtqnnmvjod, eu-west-1). Postgres 15, Auth, Storage, Realtime, pgvector, pg_cron, pg_net. 57 Edge Functions Deno dans supabase/functions/. CI/CD: push main -> GitHub Actions -> Cloudflare Pages + Supabase edge auto-deploy.

Abstraction IA dans _shared/ai-provider.ts. Modeles (CLAUDE_MODELS): sonnet=claude-sonnet-4-20250514, haiku=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001, DEEPSEEK=deepseek-chat. callPublicAI = DeepSeek SEUL (public marketplace/support, cost control decision 2026-04-17, AUCUN fallback Claude -> erreur si down). callAgentAI = Claude primaire + fallback DeepSeek si Claude echoue. callClaude/callDeepSeek = directs sans fallback. computeCost (via table PRICING) correct -> ai_usage_logs. NB: ai-copilot et kyc-screening font leur propre appel Anthropic direct (hors ai-provider). pii-redaction.ts utilisee sur le texte libre public (extract-lead) mais PAS par ai-copilot (contexte CRM brut). Photo-vision via Claude Vision.

5 audiences gardees par PasswordGate -> StaleBundleDetector -> ProtectedRoute/SuperAdminGuard. Marketplace SPA app.megga.ch (/buy /rent SearchPage; fiche /propriete/:id -> PropertyXSinglePropertyPage Property X, alias /listing/:id) -- NB le storefront PUBLIC pre-launch = site STATIQUE megga.ch (cf storefront-static), pas la SPA. Compte visiteur (/account). KYC self-service (/kyc/:token). Portail vendeur (/portal/:token = page unique « Votre vente » Sugar Pure lecture seule; + /portal dev mock). CRM agent (/dashboard/*). Super-admin (/dashboard/admin/*).

CRM agent (layout AgentSugarLayout, dark): dashboard (TodaySugar KPI), pipeline (deals par stage), contacts (+detail), listings (+detail/new wizard/edit), transactions/:id (stepper 8 etapes + banniere KYC + offres), matching, journey, calendar (Google/Outlook), documents (+generate/templates), kyc (+:dossierId/export PDF), network, audit (journal nLPD), analytics, settings. Onboarding: /dashboard/onboarding -> /dashboard/premier-jour.

Super-admin 14 pages sous /dashboard/admin/* (accent violet, SuperAdminGuard): agencies (+detail), users (impersonate audite), monitoring, marketplace (moderation), compliance, support, changelog, feature-flags, plans, live (feed temps reel), security, nps. Silo RLS separe sur tables admin_*.

Tables par domaine: tenant (agencies, profiles, agency_profiles, agent_profiles, team_invitations); contacts (contacts, seller_leads, contact_scores); biens (properties, listings, market_listings ~33k, external_listings); pipeline (transactions, crm_offers+history, visits, client_searches, matches); KYC (kyc_cases, kyc_checklist_items, kyc_magic_links+uploads, kyc_screening_decisions, documents); portail (seller_portals, seller_preferences, vendor_dossiers); billing (subscriptions); messaging (message_threads, messages, email_messages_cache); audit (activity_events, auth_events, platform_metrics, flatfox_sync_runs). Detail: docs/schema.md.

RLS agency-first. Agents: WHERE agency_id IN (SELECT agency_id FROM profiles WHERE id=auth.uid()). Anon marketplace: market_listings SELECT WHERE status='active'; inquiries/newsletter INSERT only. Acheteur: ses message_threads (buyer_user_id=auth.uid()). Vendeur: via seller_portals.token (stateless). service_role: edge functions, triggers ecrivent activity_events actor_kind='system'. RLS active sur CHAQUE table.

Pipeline marketplace: cron flatfox-sync-daily (0 4 * * *, 04:00 UTC) -> edge flatfox-sync (chunked self-invoke, 5 pages/chunk, rate-limit 1 req/s, lock singleton, safety >=80% vus avant sweep). UPSERT market_listings (source_id UNIQUE), photos -> Cloudflare R2 via photo-processor (photos_cf), quality_score + relevance_score GENERATED. Observabilite: table flatfox_sync_runs.

Regles perf DB (statement timeout 3-8s sur 33k rows): JAMAIS count:'exact' (-> seq scan, utiliser estimated); JAMAIS ORDER BY sans partial index couvrant le WHERE; .eq('status','active') pas .in(...) (IN ne matche pas les partial indexes); ne pas SELECT description/photos en liste (66MB). Index: idx_ml_rent_active_created (rent+active+quality>=50), idx_market_listings_tx_type_status.

Jobs pg_cron: flatfox-sync-daily (0 4 * * *) -> flatfox-sync; platform-metrics-hourly (15 * * * *) -> admin-monitoring; + automation-engine, ai-billing-monitor, weekly-report, search-alert. Declenches via pg_net http_post vers les edge functions.

Edge functions IA: ai-copilot (chat agent + actions structurees, Claude), ai-search (semantique pgvector), dashboard-ai-hint, parse-search-query (DeepSeek, public), support-chatbot. Plus extraction: extract-lead, extract-property-pdf, extract-property-url, photo-labeler (Vision). Secrets: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, DEEPSEEK_API_KEY.

Edge functions KYC/compliance: kyc-screening (Dilisense PEP/sanctions + analyse contextuelle Claude), magic-link-create/get/confirm/regenerate/send-email/upload (HMAC-SHA256), delete-account (nLPD art.32), log-auth-event (IP hashee salt quotidien), audit-pdf-export (chaine de hash SHA-256, LBA 10 ans). Validation humaine MLRO obligatoire.

Email (Resend): send-email, send-property-email, send-relance-email, send-reminder-email, send-team-invite, send-visit-email, detect-new-device. Paiements (Stripe): stripe-checkout, stripe-portal, stripe-webhook (signature STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET), admin-stripe-metrics (MRR/ARR/churn).

Media: photo-processor (R2), backfill-cf-images, c2pa-sign/verify (Content Credentials), public-staging (Gemini, rate-limit IP), virtual-staging (garde-fous LPD: Vision gate confidence>=85% + quota plan). Divers: translate-on-demand (DeepSeek + cache), deepgram-token/speech-to-text, ticket-ai-reply, automation-engine (cron), matching-engine, score-engine, search-alert, calendars Google/Outlook.

FLUX A (sync -> marketplace): pg_cron 04:00 -> flatfox-sync -> UPSERT market_listings (photos->R2, quality/relevance) -> RLS anon status='active' -> /rent via useMarketListings (partial index) -> /listing/:id -> marketplace_inquiries -> creation contact.

FLUX B (contact -> closing): lead (import IA/web/portal) -> contacts -> qualif (score) -> visits -> offres (crm_offers + contre-offres, trigger audit) -> transactions stages (new_lead->to_qualify->active_search->visit_planned->visit_done->interest_confirmed->offer->negotiation->reserved->financing->notary->signed) -> gate KYC (LBA art.7, WARN non bloquant, revu MLRO) -> closing + activity_events.

FLUX C (portail vendeur token): agent cree seller_portals (token 6 mois) -> vendeur /portal/:token sans login -> page unique « Votre vente » (VotreVentePage, Sugar Pure, lecture seule; remplace l'ancien mini-CRM 8 pages) -> RLS via token (READ property/transac, UPLOAD documents) -> updates visibles CRM -> expiry revoque. FLUX D (KYC Dilisense): transaction reserved -> kyc_cases (vigilance standard/renforcee selon montant + source des fonds) -> magic link upload (OCR, sha256) -> screening async Dilisense -> kyc_screening_decisions (PEP/sanctions) -> revue humaine MLRO -> analyse qualitative Claude (assist).

FLUX E (matching): client_searches (criteria JSONB) -> matching-engine compare budget/zones/type vs market_listings+properties -> matches (score+raisons) -> envoi agent -> alertes email (market_alerts/search-alert cron Resend). FLUX F (audit): tout changement -> triggers SECURITY DEFINER -> activity_events immutable (actor_id+kind, severity, category, metadata) -> timeline contact + audit super-admin + export PDF signe.

Compliance Suisse. LBA/KYC: kyc_cases vigilance standard/renforcee, source des fonds (crypto/mixte -> description >=20 car requise), screening PEP/sanctions Dilisense, validation MLRO obligatoire, retention 10 ans. nLPD/LPD: activity_events immutable, retention_until, droit effacement (delete-account), redaction PII AVANT IA, IP hashees. Integrite media: C2PA sur photos IA. IA = assistance/estimation, jamais automatique/garantie.

Design: minimal/transparent (Linear/Notion). Bentos rounded-xl border border-theme-border SANS ombres. Boutons style ghost (border + text-theme-secondary), JAMAIS bg-accent text-white. Badges texte colore sans fond. Modals TOUJOURS createPortal(document.body) z-[100]. Tokens theme (bg-theme-*, text-theme-*, border-theme-*). Marketplace: atoms Property X (Px*) = source de verite, ne pas recreer; tokens PX.*. Pages /design-system/* = source de verite.

Pieges critiques: Realtime -> TOUJOURS useId() pour le nom de channel (sinon crash au re-mount). formatCHF()/formatRent() type-defensive (accepte string/null), ne jamais .toFixed() sur valeur de form. Prix CHF 720'000 (apostrophe suisse). Surface 120 m2. Date DD.MM.YYYY. JAMAIS bg-white/text-gray-*/border-gray-* (cassent dark mode). Pas de any TS. RLS sur chaque table. Pas de console.log en prod. Ne pas mentionner Lovable/Claude/ChatGPT dans l'UI.

MEGGA AI (copilote, edge ai-copilot): bouton flottant Sparkles ghost sur toute page agent, panel slide-in. Commandes naturelles: resume ce client, redige une relance, quels biens envoyer, prepare un mandat, prochaines actions, resume les objections. REGLE: toujours nourri par les vraies donnees CRM du contact/bien/deal actif, jamais de reponse dans le vide.

Matching IA acheteurs<->biens: nouveau bien -> analyse tous les acheteurs + client_searches -> score 0-100 (budget/zone/type/pieces/surface/features) -> classe -> envoi 1 clic. Nouvel acheteur -> propose les biens actifs pertinents. Surveillance continue si client_searches.is_active: nouveaux biens / changements de prix / remises en ligne -> notification agent.

Relances intelligentes (edge automation-engine + send-reminder-email): bien envoye J+3, visite J+1 (feedback), lead inactif J+30, acheteur chaud non relance J+7, vendeur sans suivi J+14, document manquant J+3. Creent des suggestions/taches, PAS d'envois silencieux sauf si l'agent active explicitement l'envoi auto. L'agent garde toujours le controle.

Buyer Intelligence (score-engine): serieux 0-100, budget reel estime, timing (immediat/1-3/3-6/6-12 mois/long terme), proba achat 0-100, engagement very_high->dormant. Seller Intelligence: tension (calm/moderate/tense/critical), risque insatisfaction, proba accepter une baisse 0-100, urgence. Tout affiche comme 'estimation IA', indicatif.

Copilote negociation (spec ai-modules 8.7): marge (offre vs prix demande vs marche), timing (duree en vente, nb visites), strategie de contre-offre, interet probable acheteur. Generation d'annonce: SEULE l'action draft_description existe (annonce 150-250 mots); les multi-versions (standard/premium/luxe/courte/reseaux) sont une SPEC non encore codee. Analyse objections post-visite -> visits.rapport.objections (alimente l'analyse affichee anonymisee au portail vendeur).

Recherche IA conversationnelle (edge ai-search): query langage naturel -> embedding -> pgvector top-20 listings -> prompt Claude (listings + historique + contraintes) -> filtre/classe/repond -> carte + liste. Garde-fous: pas de discrimination, pas de contenu trompeur, redirige vers agent humain si offre/negociation/juridique, max 10 tours, cible <2s, disclaimer 'a titre indicatif'.

Garde-fous IA (absolus): l'IA ne contacte JAMAIS un client sans validation agent (sauf relance auto explicitement activee); ne modifie JAMAIS prix/statut/etape pipeline sans action humaine; n'envoie JAMAIS de document juridique sans validation; scores buyer/seller = 'estimation IA' indicative, pas verite; copilote negociation = suggestions pas decisions; toute action IA loggee dans activity_events avec actor_id='ai'. Human-in-the-loop obligatoire.

Score de risque KYC (calculateRiskScore dans src/lib/kycUtils.ts + edge kyc-screening): 5 facteurs - nationalite FATF/GAFI 25pts, PEP 25pts, montant >5M 20pts, PM vs PP 15pts, docs incomplets 15pts -> 0-100 low/medium/high. Listes FATF_HIGH_RISK_COUNTRIES / FATF_INCREASED_MONITORING dans src/lib/constants.ts. dilisense checkIndividual/checkEntity (PEP + Sanctions separes). Label 'estimation IA', validation MLRO humaine obligatoire.

La RLS gere le filtrage par agency (pas de WHERE agency_id explicite cote front).

Safety: >=80% des listings attendus vus avant qu'un sweep ne marque les manquants comme removed (anti-wipe). Photos -> Cloudflare R2 via photo-processor (3 variants thumb/detail/hero -> photos_cf). Tracking par run dans flatfox_sync_runs.

_shared/ai-provider.ts: abstraction multi-IA. Modeles CLAUDE_MODELS: sonnet=claude-sonnet-4-20250514, haiku=claude-haiku-4-5-20251001; deepseek-chat. Fonctions: callClaude/callDeepSeek (directs, sans fallback); callPublicAI = DeepSeek SEUL (marketplace/support public, AUCUN fallback Claude - decision 2026-04-17, erreur si down); callAgentAI = Claude primaire + fallback DeepSeek sur echec Claude. computeCost (PRICING) correct -> ai_usage_logs. Balance DeepSeek via ai-billing-monitor (cron). photo-vision.ts = Claude Vision. pii-redaction.ts (AVS/IBAN/passeport) sur texte libre public (extract-lead), PAS par ai-copilot. virtual-staging (garde-fous LPD): gate photo-vision (Claude Vision -> confidence >=85%, quality >=50/100, AUCUNE personne detectee) avant generation; prompt enrichi par Claude Haiku; image via Google AI (Gemini Nano Banana). Quota/mois par plan: starter 0, pro 50, agency 200. public-staging = version publique rate-limitee 5/h/IP. Resultat -> Storage + ai_generated_photos + activity_events.

audit-pdf-export: exporte activity_events en PDF (filtres date/categorie/severite/recherche), signe par chaine de hash SHA-256 (chaque event = SHA(prev_hash + canonical_json)) -> integrite verifiable. Conformite nLPD art.12 (tracabilite) + LBA art.7 al.3 (conservation 10 ans). Sortie {pdf base64, hash, chain_hash, count}. Front: lib/auditPdfExport.ts (jsPDF) + auditCsvExport.ts.

Photos marketplace optimisees -> Cloudflare R2 (champ photos_cf) via photo-processor.

Detection localStorage -> browser. Switch = LanguageChangeOverlay shimmer 350ms. Garder les 4 langues synchro (skill i18n-sync).

Agent WhatsApp (feature phare #2): vision = l'agent immobilier est toujours sur WhatsApp. Phase 1 (mergee) = miroir entrant lecture seule (valide e2e sur Meta reel: message client -> CRM). Phase 2 (mergee) = envoi sortant (gateway send + edge whatsapp-send + composer CdWhatsAppCard): CODE deploye + tests unit 7/7 + appel Graph API OK, MAIS envoi vers un combine reel NON confirme (bloque par allowlist 131030 et moyen de paiement Meta en mode test). Phase 3 (en cours) = l'agent interroge MEGGA AI depuis WhatsApp (appairage + routage webhook -> ai-copilot), lecture seule. Suite: actions ('je veux visiter' -> visite CRM), notifications templates, sync statut delivery.

WhatsApp architecture: couche d'abstraction supabase/functions/_shared/whatsapp-gateway.ts (interface WhatsAppProvider: parseInbound + buildSendTextRequest + parseSendResult). Providers: OpenWA (prototype local localhost:2785) ET Meta Cloud API (officielle, DEJA EN PROD inbound+outbound). Selection par WHATSAPP_PROVIDER (defaut meta). Webhook signe HMAC-SHA256 (verifyHmac timing-safe, Web Crypto), detection provider par header (x-openwa-signature vs x-hub-signature-256), handshake GET Meta (hub.challenge). Secrets: WHATSAPP_WEBHOOK_SECRET, META_APP_SECRET, WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN, META_WHATSAPP_TOKEN, META_PHONE_NUMBER_ID (1153218994539921), WHATSAPP_PROVIDER.

WhatsApp flux inbound (edge whatsapp-webhook): message -> webhook POST -> verifie signature HMAC (401 si invalide, 500 si secret absent) -> parse via gateway (NormalizedInboundMessage) -> mapping best-effort wa_from -> contacts.phone (9 derniers chiffres) -> contact_id + agency_id -> INSERT idempotent whatsapp_messages (upsert onConflict provider+provider_message_id) -> activity_events 'whatsapp_message_received' (non bloquant) -> 200. Mapping contact et audit en try/catch (best-effort, resilient).

Tables WhatsApp. whatsapp_messages: id, provider (openwa/meta), provider_message_id, direction (inbound/outbound), wa_from/wa_to (digits only), contact_id FK, agency_id FK, body, media_type (image/audio/video/document/location/contact/sticker), media_url, status (received/read/failed), wa_timestamp, raw jsonb (debug Phase1, a PURGER Phase4). UNIQUE(provider, provider_message_id) = idempotence. Index (contact_id, created_at), (agency_id, created_at). contact_messages = formulaire public /contact (name/email/phone/subject/message, consent_privacy LPD obligatoire, status new/answered/archived/spam).

WhatsApp RLS/securite: policy whatsapp_messages_agency_select -> agency_id = get_my_agency_id() (un agent ne voit que les messages de son agence; messages non mappes agency_id NULL invisibles sauf super_admin via is_super_admin()). Vigilance LBA. Standard (art.3-4): 4 checks obligatoires id+address+pep+sanctions (defaut: PP, montant <100k CHF). Renforcee (art.6): ajoute le 5e check 'source des fonds' obligatoire; declenchee si vigilance='renforced' OU transaction >100'000 CHF. source_of_funds_type: salary/sale_property/sale_business/inheritance/investment/crypto/loan/mixed/other. crypto et mixed exigent une description >=20 caracteres + AuditEvent severity=warn (signalement MLRO).

Screening (edge kyc-screening): nom+nationalite DERIVES server-side depuis kyc_cases.contact_id (anti prompt injection). Appel Dilisense v1 checkIndividual/checkEntity (header x-api-key DILISENSE_API_KEY, fuzzy_search, timeout 15s). Separe hits PEP (source_type PEP) et Sanctions -> statuts not_checked/pending/clear/match, rollback si timeout (ne fige pas en pending). Puis Claude Sonnet 4 (optionnel, graceful degradation si API down): qualitative_risk, vigilance_recommendation, patterns_detected, justification, confidence -> kyc_cases.ai_analysis. Magic link KYC (upload client sans compte, Sprint 4.7.A): 1) CREATE (magic-link-create): token signe HMAC-SHA256 = base64url(payload).base64url(sig), le payload contient SEULEMENT magic_link.id (jamais kyc_case_id/contact_id), exp 7j (max 30). 2) SEND-EMAIL: URL kyc.megga.ch/{token} + message custom (Resend). 3) UPLOAD (public, KycPublicPage): verif token + SHA-256 du fichier, sanitize filename, upload bucket kyc-documents path {agency}/{case}/{ts}_{name}, INSERT documents status=pending. 4) CONFIRM: status=confirmed/revoked. 5) REGENERATE (max 3). Isolation cross-agency, expiry+HMAC anti-forgery.

Signatures cryptographiques & integrite. C2PA Content Credentials (edge c2pa-sign, provider via env C2PA_PROVIDER) - 3 niveaux: Capture/Numbers Protocol (C2PA officiel + certificat), Trufo API (~0.01$/img), ou MEGGA Shield PAR DEFAUT (SHA-256 + EXIF, gratuit, PAS un vrai C2PA -> transparence du badge necessaire). Stocke c2pa_verified/_at/_method. c2pa-verify (public no-auth): c2pa-wasm sinon heuristique marqueurs JUMBF/C2PA -> {verified, manifest}. Magic-link HMAC-SHA256 (magic-link-token.ts): token base64url(payload).base64url(sig), payload {id, exp} uniquement, secret MEGGA_MAGIC_LINK_HMAC_SECRET >=32, timing-safe. Audit hash chain (audit-pdf-export): hash[i]=SHA256(hash[i-1] + canonical(event)), immuable, nLPD art.12 + LBA art.7 (10 ans), PDF avec chainHash.

E-signature qualifiee — PLAN (decision produit). Swisscom QES ABANDONNE. L'e-signature passera par une integration au CHOIX dans les parametres d'integration: Skribble OU DocuSign. MODELE: l'agence cree son compte chez le fournisseur, le CONNECTE dans MEGGA (OAuth/cle API), puis signe ses documents en UN CLIC (mandats, offres, contrats). Skribble = suisse, QES/AES conforme ZertES/eIDAS (prefere CH); DocuSign = international, large adoption. STATUT: PLANIFIE, pas encore code (MandateSignModal actuel = UI simulee a remplacer). Archi probable: connexion provider stockee par agence -> edge sign-document -> API du provider connecte -> webhook callback (signe) -> statut document + certificat + horodatage.
